svg.title: Sprint 2: three Actor-Web nodes on one machine
svg.desc: Two workers dial the control node over authenticated loopback WebSockets. Each checks its own candidate and keeps its own execution claim, count and receipt. Control admits receipts by source and binding. Its private task owner decides and its team claims Review. The browser reads one workspace per credential from a separate gateway. The launcher uses private IPC, not the check or receipt channel. No VM is involved.

g.text: Each viewer credential reads one workspace.
Launcher · private IPC to the three nodes
Starts the run or requests lookup; never relays receipts.
Peer adapter: authenticated source selects the lane; the receipt must match its pinned binding.
Private actors: the owner accepts or holds the check; the team claims the handoff before starting Review.
Per-lane checkpoint: pinned attempt, decision, pending handoff, team claim and stage records.

svg.text: Execute or look up → worker; receipt or miss → control

g.text: Host records: execution claim, count and receipt.
Host records: execution claim, count and receipt.

svg.text: “Local” and “cloud” name executor bindings. Both workers run a UTF-8 label check in a Node.js process, not a guest VM.
